content: The same footnote records coins struck by Sulṭān-Ḥusayn, Sulṭān-Abū Saʿīd and Jahānshāh Qara Quyunlu bearing the phrase ʿAlī walī Allāh on the face and the names of the first three caliphs on the obverse.
refers_to_primary: Coins of Sulṭān-Ḥusayn, Sulṭān-Abū Saʿīd and Jahānshāh Qara Quyunlu (per MK fn.129)
